pluginstrument.description: Title: ISIS (Integrated Standby Instrument System) for FlyByWire Airbus A320 (Air Manager instrument) Simulator(s): MSFS 2020 Author: Yves Levesque and Alexander Hildmann Version: 1.0.0 IMPORTANT: To use "Illumination mode", Illumination Pedestal Captain instrument is needed. Informations: Brightness button + - sets brightness in Cockpit only, not for the popout ERRORS: Brightness button + - does not work properly. After change in instrument seems to set back to value set in cockpit 2022-03-03 Initial versionYL 2024-12-21 YL v3.0 Adapt to MSFS2024 2025-06-09 YL v3.0.3 Correct baro knob for dev version
